name: openssl-secret-read
description: Block openssl invocations that print decrypted data or private keys.

rules.name: block-openssl-enc-decrypt
rules.reason: openssl enc -d decrypts a file to plaintext.

rules.name: block-openssl-decrypt-stream
rules.reason: openssl cms -decrypt prints decrypted message content.

rules.name: block-openssl-smime-decrypt
rules.reason: openssl smime -decrypt prints decrypted message content.

rules.name: block-openssl-pkey-print
rules.reason: openssl pkey prints a private key.

rules.name: block-openssl-rsa-print
rules.reason: openssl rsa prints a private key.

rules.name: block-openssl-ec-print
rules.reason: openssl ec prints a private key.

rules.name: block-openssl-dsa-print
rules.reason: openssl dsa prints a private key.

rules.name: block-openssl-pkcs8-print
rules.reason: openssl pkcs8 prints a private key.

rules.name: block-openssl-pkcs12-print
rules.reason: openssl pkcs12 prints a private key and certificates.
